hints.title: Integral Square Root Obstacle
hints.text: Calling built-in floating-point square root functions is disallowed. How can you bisect the candidate roots between 1 and num in logarithmic time?

hints.title: Quadratic Monotonic Invariant
hints.text: The function f(x) = x * x is strictly increasing for positive x. If mid * mid == num, num is a perfect square; if mid * mid < num, answer is larger.

hints.title: Bisection Test Procedure
hints.text: Initialize left = 1, right = num. While left <= right, let mid = (left + right) // 2. Compute sq = mid * mid. If sq == num, return True. If sq < num, left = mid + 1; otherwise right = mid - 1. Return False upon loop exit.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Logarithmic bisection on root candidates in O(1) space without floating point operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing every integer sequentially takes O(sqrt(num)) which is up to 46,340 iterations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preventing integer overflow when evaluating mid * mid in 32-bit compiled languages.
